messages:
incident-bot: Pager: control-plane 5xx error-rate spike detected across auth and org-lookup deps. Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx > 4% for 5m. Links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/5512345678 :rotating_light:

alex.k: saw it. I'm oncall. beginning quick triage — checking deploys and recent config rollouts.

jen.s: i'm up. looks correlated with the new config rollout to gateway-edges (rolling-config v2026.03.11). org-lookup latencies jump and then downstream 502/504s.

dave.i: checking infra telemetry — there was a short heartbeat drop to control-plane consul at 17:02 UTC that aligns with the spike. also a surge in token validation calls to auth-service.

alex.k: customer impact? any billing or dedicated customers hitting errors?

maya.p: posted a quick check to support: ~24 users reported failed API calls in last 10m, mostly higher TPS customers on hosted tier. No billing failures reported yet.

jen.s: looking at traces. Pattern: gateway -> auth -> org-lookup. auth returns 500 internal after timeout to org-lookup. stack shows https://git.redwood/auth-service main -> `OrgClient.lookup` timed out.

alex.k: mitigation plan idea: 1) temporarily route traffic to fallback cached-org endpoint 2) throttle token-parsing bulk calls 3) pause config rollout. Who can flip the gateway route?

dave.i: I can flip the route. Will add temporary `x-feature: cached-org-lookup` override at LB. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: route-override cached-org-lookup -> applied to 5/6 edges.

alex.k: after route override: error-rate dropped from 4.3% -> 1.2% within 90s. Good signal that org-lookup instability is main vector.

jen.s: digging into org-lookup — DB connection pool reported `max_connections reached` and retries cascading. Someone pushed a change to pool sizing in last deploys?

dave.i: yes, config v2026.03.11 included `orglookup.max_pool=50` in some regions due to presumed idle leaks; seems we accidentally reduced pool in autoscaled clusters. I'm reverting that config on the control plane config service now.

alex.k: revert in progress? ETA?

dave.i: revert applied to staging, rolling to prod now. patch id: cfg-551234-revert. Rolling 6 clusters, ~2m each.

jen.s: while revert rolls, propose relaxing circuit-breaker thresholds on auth so it fails fast and avoids cascading retries. Set `auth.retry=1` and `circuit.window=30s` temporarily. 

alex.k: agreed. jen, can you push that change?

jen.s: pushed temporary override to auth-config via runtime flags. Monitoring.

maya.p: support update: telling affected customers we have mitigation in place and are doing a config rollback; ETA 10-15m for full restoration. No invoicing impact expected.

alex.k: good. quick postmortem notes: probable root cause = misconfigured pool + config rollout -> connection exhaustion -> org-lookup timeouts -> auth 5xx -> gateway errors.

jen.s: logs snippet from org-lookup: ```WARN org.lookup.ConnectionPool - maxConnections=50 reached, inflight=52
ERROR org.lookup.LookupHandler - timed out waiting for connection after 15000ms
```

alex.k: customer-facing metric: error-rate down to 0.8% and trending to baseline. We'll keep overrides until rollback completes and stable for 10m.

dave.i: revert finished on 4/6 clusters. two left. no regressions so far. Handoff: i'll stay until fully rolled and stable.

jen.s: i'm running a smoke-set of prompts and auth flows; no 5xx for last 3m.

incident-bot: Alert update: severity downgraded to P2. Next check-in in 15m.

maya.p: prepping comms for customers that opened tickets. Draft: "We experienced elevated errors due to a configuration change affecting org lookup pools; we reverted the change and applied short-term routing mitigations; service is recovering."

alex.k: agreed. jen/dave remain onwatch. I'll hand to night oncall in 45m if stable. tagging incident in ops tracker: https://ops.redwood/incidents/5512345678/summary

jen.s: before close, we'll add guardrail: config validation step to catch pool <= recommended-min. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

dave.i: created ticket INFRA-1229 for validation + add circuit-breaker alert tuning.

alex.k: nice. final status: mitigation applied (cached-org route), config revert rolling, auth CB tightened, customer comms drafted. Leaving thread open until stable 30m post full rollback.

maya.p: thanks all. :heart:
